description: Townsville Bicycle Counts is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Townsville City Council. Bicycle Network’s ‘Super Counts’ programs count the volumes of bicycles and other active travellers, and their movements on roads and paths. Road users are counted visually by volunteers. This dataset is an extract of the Bicycle Network Super Counts Data Dashboard 2024, specifically the Bicycle Network Commuter Volume Data, for the Townsville Local Government area. Coverage: Townsville. The portal files it under the publisher Townsville City Council. Its tags are bicycle, bicycle count, bicycle volume. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-11-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
